ideas.title: Investigating the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the allegations against the defendants and the impact on Minnesota's welfare system.
questions: How did the defendants allegedly carry out the fraud scheme?
What were the vulnerabilities in Minnesota's welfare system that allowed the scheme to occur?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the vulnerabilities in Minnesota's welfare system. By following the money and investigating the allegations, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform future investigations.
